title: Lithium inside Posners may explain lithium therapy for mania

statements.text: If two lithium ions replace the central calcium of a Posner molecule as it forms, they would decohere the phosphorus spins, a possible explanation for the efficacy of lithium in tempering mania in bipolar disorder.

sources.quote: offering a possible explanation for the remarkable efficacy of lithium in tempering mania in patients with bipolar disorder
